title: presheaf-indexed-fiber
description: A predication-fiber-algebra packaged as a presheaf F : C^op -> Bilat on a small context category, generated by indexing the bare fiber over projection contexts so that context-restricted reads become functorial. It separates the value-domain at each context from the restriction discipline between contexts.

contextCategory.description: a small context category C whose objects are projection contexts c and whose morphisms f : c' -> c are context restrictions (narrowings); the canonical substrate instance is the poset C_sub on {0,1,2} x Peers x Sessions x N

valueDomain.description: F(c) <= A_p, the sub-bilattice of cell-atom values that context c is permitted to see

restriction.description: F(f) : F(c) -> F(c'), each a knowledge-order (vee_k semilattice) preserving bilattice homomorphism implementing atom-set restriction

functoriality.description: presheaf laws: F(id_c) = id_{F(c)} and F(g . f) = F(f) . F(g)

restrictionIsProjection.description: F(f) forgets atoms outside the narrower context but is non-destructive: unchosen atoms remain in the un-restricted fiber and reappear under any context that admits them

mergeNaturality.description: the knowledge-join merge is a natural transformation: F(f) . merge = merge . (F(f) x F(f)) for every restriction f
